name: Darkspear Islands Clash

angles.text: Alliance high command calls champion volunteers to reinforce the front against the Darkspear Raiders and protect strategic positions in the islands.
As a warrior, you bear the brunt of the assault against fierce troll raiders. Your discipline and valor can turn the tide of battle.
As a paladin, you bring resolve to the violent clashes, answering the Alliance call to protect its people and repel hostile forces.

faq.answer: Alliance officers overseeing the fighting call champions to face the Darkspear Raiders. Warriors prove their service by recovering marks of honor from the battle.

aliases: who are we fighting in darkspear islands
faq.answer: The Darkspear Raiders are troll warbands fighting for control of the Darkspear Islands. Their fierce attacks threaten Alliance footholds and prompt urgent calls for reinforcements.

The Alliance fights to hold strategic ground in the Darkspear Islands and keep the region from falling under troll control. Losing ground would weaken Alliance influence and security across the contested coastal waters.
faq.q: Why is the Alliance fighting on the Darkspear Islands?

aliases: who takes darkspear marks of honor
faq.answer: An Alliance Brigadier General stationed outside the battlegrounds oversees troop mobilization and receives returning champions' proof of battlefield service.
faq.q: Who issues and completes this mission?

aliases: how to prove front line service
faq.answer: Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor are military tokens for valor and active service on the front line. Warriors present three marks to an Alliance Brigadier General as proof of their service in battle.
faq.q: What are Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor?

aliases: what happens if alliance loses darkspear islands
faq.answer: Without rapid reinforcements, relentless Darkspear Raider attacks could bring Alliance positions on the Darkspear Islands to complete collapse. Holding the islands keeps hostile forces from claiming unchallenged dominance over the archipelago.
faq.q: What is at stake if the Alliance fails?

sections.body: Open war now rages across the Darkspear Islands between the Alliance and the aggressive Darkspear Raiders. Alliance commanders fear their foothold in the archipelago will be overwhelmed without urgent reinforcements. So they call capable champions to the front to stem the attack.
sections.title: A Contested Front

sections.body: Alliance commanders need proven fighters willing to serve on the front lines. Warriors bring back Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor as proof of their service. The marks uphold discipline and honor those whose courage turns the battle.
sections.title: Proof of Valor

summary: Across the Darkspear Islands, Alliance forces are hard pressed. Without help at the front, they risk losing the whole archipelago to the fierce Darkspear Raiders.
attribution: In-game quest text: Darkspear Islands Clash
